speaker: Doctor
text:
That is strange, as I haven't received any initial symptoms yet. To start, have you noticed any specific patterns to your double vision, such as it worsening when looking down or reading? 

REQUEST TEST: Blood panel for electrolytes and muscle enzymes.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for the normal blood work; that rules out metabolic causes like myasthenia gravis. Since your symptoms include difficulty climbing stairs and upper limb weakness, have you noticed any trouble with fine motor tasks, such as buttoning your shirt or holding a cup?

speaker: Patient
text: The double vision usually happens when I look up or down, and the weakness in my arms and legs gets worse after activity but improves if I rest. I have not noticed balance problems or numbness.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Ocular Myasthenia Gravis with generalized involvement (despite normal initial blood work, the specific symptom pattern of worsening with activity and improvement with rest, combined with diplopia on upward/downward gaze and proximal muscle weakness, is classic for Myasthenia Gravis; the normal enzymes may rule out myopathy but do not exclude MG). Please confirm if you have noticed ptosis (drooping eyelids) or double vision that fluctuates throughout the day.
